title: Blind adversarial review of partial-agreement bounds
question: Is HYP-5da6025e correct as stated?
claims: (1),(1a),(1b),(1d) correct; (2) false as transcribed (missing N <= (r-1)/2); counterexample y^2=x^3+5/F_7.

review.rationale: Restore N <= (r-1)/2 for (2); soften "N < p necessary" to "N <= min(p,r) suffices"; state h_j nonvanishing as a dichotomy.
counterexamples: y^2 = x^3 + 5 over F_7, P = (3,2), A = {1..6}, g = 5X (14 violations in 40832 anomalous symmetric tests; others at p = 13, 19).
No violation of (1)-(1d) in 3348 random/structured cases (p <= 47) and 26218 exhaustive N = p cases (p <= 11).
review.limitations: Toy sizes; Corollaries 1c and 2b of the author report not reviewed; novelty not reviewed.
review.initial_packet: Exact HYP-5da6025e statement only; author report withheld until initial findings.
